summary: Amazon competitor intelligence engine. Produces analytical output focused on a defined set of competitors: either a one-shot deep teardown (Full Scan: 28-35 credits, 11 endpoints, battle card, side-by-side comparison, pricing/review/inventory breakdown) OR sustained per-competitor monitoring with alerts (Quick Check: 5-10 credits, realtime polling, baseline diff). Input: keyword, ASIN(s), or brand — whatever identifies the competitor set to analyze. Output is per-competitor analytical insight tied to that specific set. Use when the user wants focused analysis on identified competitors: a one-shot teardown or an ongoing per-competitor watch. Use when user asks: analyze competitor B07XXX, battle card for ASIN Y, side-by-side competitor teardown, monitor a competitor brand, deep analysis of these 3 competitors, ongoing watch on a defined competitor set. Requires ZOODATA_API_KEY.
